basis: official Madrid OS4.0.11 product EROFS; sizes measured with dump.erofs; package manifests inspected with aapt2; config references scanned; candidates cross-referenced with Mundo removals
policy: Remove only explicitly approved optional packages.
Preserve one normal built-in input method; SogouIME is retained for clean-v0.
Replace donor madrid.xml with official peridot.xml, so stale Madrid-only device-feature package references are not carried forward.
Remove privileged-permission blocks for removed privileged game services.
Do not remove framework, telephony, security core, updater, search, health HALs, or debug infrastructure solely for space.
Every approved removal has a regression-test expectation and may be reverted independently.
